evidence.quote: buying nature runes (50 per world until you have 500)
15 oak logs, digsite teleport and run to the sawmill, make them into planks
show the barcrawl card to the Barbarian Guard to complete the barcrawl
Save 50 oak planks for future uses
collect the Lumbridge & Draynor easy diary
upgrade your Iban’s staff at the Dark Mage
start Between a Rock… at Dondakan
Take an earth spell (staff + runes, earth bolt works great) from the bank
you need to have mined 2000 stardust by now. If you haven’t, do that first
collect the ice gloves by killing the Ice Queen
add it to a fishing rod to make an oily rod
continue and complete Death to the Dorgeshuun
doing the Tears of Guthix quest
Collect the Varrock easy and medium diary rewards
resume and complete the Temple of the Eye
Buy the ancient staff from Eblis
Mine and bank one piece of granite (any size)
Start and complete Icthlarin’s Little Helper
Do Contact! up to the step you need to visit Osman
start A Tail of Two Cats
complete the Bear Your Soul miniquest
collect the Kourend Easy diary reward
grind 8 bones at the Ectofuntus grinder to get 40 ecto-tokens
Do In Search of the Myreque in its entirety
Start In Aid of the Myreque
Continue In Aid of the Myreque until you obtain the rod mould
Continue and complete Monkey Madness I
top up your death rune stack to 3k
save a raw chompy for later
Buy and smelt 1100 gold ore (or exactly as many as it takes to get to level 50)
Start and complete the Pandemonium quest
bank to grab the items necessary on Pandemonium
Start and complete Current Affairs in full
Start and complete Crab Quest in full
smelt your lead ore into 11 bars
Your attack should be at least level 50 by now
Train slayer to get to level 50 defence
Collect a berserker ring from Dagannoth Rex
training melee on accurate to 60 attack
start Eagles’ Peak in the Ardougne Zoo
Visit the Lair of Tarn Razorlor, start and complete the miniquest
